title: Phonological Awareness Skills — 35-Lesson Scope & Sequence Chart

overview.description: Single-page scope and sequence chart for a 35-lesson phonological awareness curriculum. Progression: Listening Games → What is a Sound → Name Game → Same or Different → Rhyme (Setting the Stage → Repetition → Recognition → Production) → Initial Phoneme Isolation → Name Work → Focus Sounds → Generating Words → Alliteration. Shows a carefully scaffolded progression from broad listening skills to precise phoneme manipulation.

gaps.name: scope-sequence-chart
gaps.description: Visual chart showing skill progression across lessons/weeks. Grid layout with skills on Y-axis and lesson numbers on X-axis. Useful for parent planning.

notes: Valuable for Homa's curriculum-writer — this shows the exact pedagogical progression for phonological awareness: listening → rhyme → phoneme isolation → alliteration. This is the teaching sequence Homa should follow when building PA curricula.
